question: Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(UserId where UpVotes = 0 and Score BETWEEN 5 and 10))*100, (COUNT(UserId where Score BETWEEN 5 and 10));
clarification: Count each distinct Id only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.UpVotes = 0, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) AS per FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.UpVotes = 0, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100/ COUNT(T1.Id) AS per FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10

c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN c.UserId END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId), 0) AS percentage FROM comments AS c JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

d.request: Among comments with scores between 5 and 10, what percentage of distinct users have 0 upvotes, counting each UserId only once?
d.sql: WITH comment_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserId FROM comments WHERE Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10 AND UserId IS NOT NULL) SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage FROM comment_users cu JOIN users u ON u.Id = cu.UserId

b.request: Among distinct users who made at least one comment with a score from 5 through 10, what percentage have 0 up votes?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage FROM users AS u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments AS c WHERE c.UserId = u.Id AND c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10);
